title: edikt SPEC sidecar
description: Structured sidecar (.yaml) that accompanies a v2 SPEC. Source of truth for requirements, ACs, coverage, and cross-references. adds source_prd/source_brainstorm/source_prompt fields to support SPECs with no upstream PRD.

allOf.description: BRAIN-NNN decision 28: exactly one of source_prd / source_brainstorm / source_prompt MUST be non-null. Encoded as oneOf so a sidecar with all three null OR more than one set fails validation.

schema_version.description: Sidecar schema version. PRD/SPEC sidecars use a string semver ("1.0") so additive field changes can ship as 1.1, 1.2, … within v1.x. The governance sidecar (gov-sidecar.v1.schema.json) intentionally uses a discrete integer (1) because its on-disk shape is a v1-or-v2 contract, not a semver-versioned one. Used by /edikt:doctor to flag stale sidecars.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug used in filenames. Matches the PRD sidecar slug field so PRD/SPEC pairs share a consistent identity model.

status.description: Lifecycle status. draft → accepted → in-progress → shipped (→ evolving for post-ship iteration). Terminal states: superseded | deprecated | cancelled. PRDs and SPECs share this enum so a status from one artifact class is meaningful when surfaced alongside the other.

source_prd.description: Set when this SPEC derives from a PRD. Exactly one of source_prd / source_brainstorm / source_prompt is non-null.

source_brainstorm.description: Set when this SPEC derives from a brainstorm doc. The brainstorm's produced_specs: receives a back-reference.

source_prompt.description: Set when this SPEC is self-contained (no upstream artifact). Stores the originating prompt (≤200 chars). No back-reference written.

source_prd_coverage.description: Only present when source_prd is set and PRD is v2. Emitted by /edikt:sdlc:spec (FR-007 change 1).

fr.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.fr_pattern, default ^FR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

items.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.sr_pattern, default ^SR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

fr.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.fr_pattern, default ^FR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

items.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.fr_pattern, default ^FR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

requirements.description: SPEC requirements (SR-NNN). Each may implement a PRD FR-NNN.

id.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.sr_pattern, default ^SR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

implements.description: Links to PRD FR. Null for spec-only requirements. Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.fr_pattern, default ^FR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

verify.description: Optional shell command that returns exit 0 when this SR is satisfied. Run via `bin/edikt verify spec <SPEC-ID>`. Used by `/edikt:sdlc:drift` (verify failures contribute to the drift signal) and by the completion-evidence discipline. Omit when no programmatic check is possible — the field stays absent, not empty.

verify_kind.description: Discriminator for the cheat-rate benchmark. Optional; required only when this SR should be scored by `bin/edikt gov benchmark cheat-rate`. Same semantics as gov-sidecar verify_kind.

intent.description: Optional one-line semantic claim the verify is meant to falsify. Generator-neutral; consumed by the cheat-rate adversary prompt when verify_kind: behavioral.

falsifying_observation.description: Optional one-line description of what a violation looks like. Sibling of intent; consumed by the cheat-rate adversary prompt.

positive_fixture_path.description: Optional path to a positive-fixture script (exits 0 against a compliant state).

negative_fixture_path.description: Optional path to a negative-fixture script (used by the cheat-rate verdict layer as the discriminator).

acceptance_criteria.description: AC-NNN-M from PRD (pass-through, source: prd) + SAC-NNN added by SPEC (source: spec).

id.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.ac_pattern, default ^AC-\d{3,}-\d+$; SAC default ^SAC-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

fr.description: Permissive superset — static JSON Schema cannot read .edikt/config.yaml, so the configured strict form (ids.fr_pattern, default ^FR-\d{3,}$) is enforced by the skill commands, not here.

verify.description: Optional shell command that mechanically validates the Given/When/Then. Exit 0 = the AC passes. Run via `bin/edikt verify spec <SPEC-ID>`; used by the drift command and the completion-evidence discipline. Omit when no programmatic check is possible.

protections.description: Inherited from PRD (source: prd) + spec-layer additions (source: spec). Mirrors the PRD sidecar's oneOf shape: each entry is EITHER a reference to an existing INV ({ref, note?}) OR a self-contained protection ({id, text}). The source discriminator records provenance.

id.description: Feature-scoped protection (SP-NNN from PRD, SSP-NNN added at SPEC layer). Promote to an INV if durable.

type.description: Reference type. Aligned with the PRD sidecar enum so PRD inheritance is type-safe; 'diagram' and 'generated' are both accepted across PRD and SPEC.

supersedes.description: When this SPEC supersedes a prior one, the earlier SPEC's ID. Mirrors the PRD sidecar's supersedes field.

superseded_by.description: When this SPEC has been superseded, the replacing SPEC's ID. Set by /edikt:sdlc:spec on supersede transition.

deprecated_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when status moved to deprecated.

deprecated_reason.description: One-line rationale captured at deprecate time.

cancelled_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp when status moved to cancelled.

cancelled_reason.description: One-line rationale captured at cancel time.

extensions.description: User-managed extension zone. LLM NEVER writes here; commands NEVER mutate this key. Free-form structure. Mirrors the PRD sidecar's extensions zone.

_sync.description: Sync block mirroring the PRD sidecar's _sync. /edikt:doctor uses these hashes to detect when the .md and .yaml have drifted out of sync.

md_hash.description: SHA-256 of the .md file at last sync. Empty string if never synced.

yaml_hash.description: SHA-256 of the .yaml file at last sync (self-referential; recomputed post-write).
